subject.title: fix: stop doctor misreporting trusted-proxy gateways as unauthenticated

question: Should Doctor classify a runtime-valid, LAN-bound trusted-proxy Gateway as configured authentication for the exposed-bind diagnostic and emit the guarded trusted-proxy WARNING, rather than the existing unauthenticated CRITICAL?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible security policy: the patch has narrowed its readiness predicate to runtime-aligned checks, but choosing the operator-facing severity for a reverse-proxy trust boundary requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept guarded trusted-proxy warning
options.body: Merge the runtime-aligned classification while preserving CRITICAL findings for invalid, unsafe, or unverifiable trusted-proxy configurations and explicit proxy/firewall guidance.

options.title: Retain unauthenticated critical
options.body: Keep every non-loopback trusted-proxy deployment on the unauthenticated CRITICAL path regardless of runtime validity.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded trusted-proxy warning
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime-aligned classification while preserving CRITICAL findings for invalid, unsafe, or unverifiable trusted-proxy configurations and explicit proxy/firewall guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR discussion directly requested this person’s decision on the remaining security-diagnostic policy.
